en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And whatever is narrated from Abdul Malik bin A'yan, I have narrated it from Muhammad bin Ali Majilwayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his uncle Muhammad bin Abi Al-Qasim, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Yunus bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdul Malik bin A'yan,
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), visited his grave in Medina with his companions.
